scenes: What if the heat warning can’t get through?
Phone masts and networks need power, and cooling. | In a long heatwave with power cuts, signals weaken.
In Bangladesh in 2026, mobile signals weakened as blackouts spread.
Warnings, mobile payments and calls for help all ride on it. | So back-up power for networks is heat protection too.
Keep the line open in the heat.
